QuestInfo.name: Easy as M.A.P.L.E.
QuestInfo.1: Participate in the Everyday Happy Time event each day to collect the Alphabet Han Gwa pieces. If you spell #eMAPLE#n, you can get awesome prizes! The event runs from 4/08/13 to 4/12/13.
QuestInfo.2: You collected all the Alphabet Han Gwa letters to spell MAPLE and received a 30-day Dragon Rider Mount coupon!

item.0: The #eEveryday Happy Time#n event will take place between 4/8/13 and 4/12/13 to celebrate the coming of Spring! You will find Alphabet Cookies during the event. Collect enough to spell #eM.A.P.L.E.#n, and you'll get awesome rewards!
